column1: # Hand-checked inputs to scripts/build-watchlist.mjs, which writes watchlist.tsv.
# Edit this file (never watchlist.tsv) and rerun the script.
#   ticker   display form (BRK.B). Tickers not in universe.txt are extra
#            companies (the hand-picked foreign ones) and need a name and tier.
#   tier     full (earnings write-ups: the S&P 100 rows below), calendar
#            (calendar only), drop (left off: the second share class of a CIK),
#            or - (full when the market-cap snapshot is $100B or more).
#   name     display name; default: universe.txt's name.
#   domains  the company's own web domains (comma-separated; subdomains
#            match), used to accept its date announcement as calendar proof.
